name: Jarl Needs a Blade
summary: In Dustwallow Marsh, Jarl needs a blade for urgent cutting. “Swamp Eye” Jarl wants a moonsteel broadsword and warns you not to dawdle.

sections.title: A Certain Blade
sections.body: “Swamp Eye” Jarl has cutting to do, but keeps its purpose to himself. He asks for a particular blade, called a moonsteel broadsword by some and a swing blade by Jarl. You might find one in town, or ask a blacksmith to make one special. Jarl warns you not to sleep on it; whatever needs cutting will not keep forever.

faq.q: Who is asking for the blade?
aliases: who gives jarl needs a blade
faq.answer: “Swamp Eye” Jarl is asking for the blade in Dustwallow Marsh.
Jarl requires a moonsteel broadsword, which Jarl calls a swing blade.

faq.q: Why does Jarl need a blade so urgently?
aliases: why does jarl need a blade
faq.answer: Jarl has cutting to do but will not say what needs cutting. Jarl warns that it will not keep forever.

faq.q: Where does Jarl suggest finding the sword?
aliases: how to get moonsteel broadsword for jarl
where to find blade for jarl
faq.answer: Jarl says you might find one in town or ask a blacksmith to make one special.
